lunar_configuration: LUNAR-PCS-01 independent surrogate; no ACR1 lunar qualification

lunar.mass_basis: 300kg retained wet reference includes280kg dry and20kg independent disposal reserve. Other captive payloads add4kg each. Single-release maps are last-payload snapshots, not a12-release campaign.
lunar.initial_state_frame: Luna-centered MJ2000Eq; inclination is not a lunar-equator claim

limits: Declared mission and uncertainty choices are investigation criteria, not customer or provider inputs.
Lunar lifetime uses a spherical reference surface and omits topography, SRP and communications/coverage criteria.
Engine thrust and Isp are sensitivity assumptions; no source-rated engine is selected.
Deliberate lunar impact is a dynamical alternative; site selection and applicable approvals are external.
No new hardware, customer, provider, compliance or independent human-review claim is made.
